thesis: Morgan Housel argues that his non-traditional education, which involved bypassing high school to focus on competitive skiing and independent study, provided a superior real-life education compared to academic memorization. He concludes that starting college at age 20 due to this path gave him the necessary maturity to succeed, though he acknowledges the inherent risk that not everyone who leaves the traditional path can return to a productive one.
